sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was explicitly reduced: Q3 revenues expected down low double digits, gross margins down 300-350 bps, and greater headwinds in Q4. Management acknowledged the need for near-term pain to reset the business, with no timeline for return to growth. The score reflects the clear downward revision in guidance and the cautious, restructuring-oriented tone.

summary.guidance: Q3 revenues expected down low double digits; Q3 gross margins down 300-350 bps; greater headwinds in Q4 vs Q3; summer '25 order books down vs prior year
summary.margin: Gross margin 43.6%, down 100 bps; EBIT margin 11.3%
key_risks: Higher markdowns and promotional activity pressuring margins
Classic footwear franchise deceleration expected to continue for several quarters
Greater China macro headwinds and competitive environment
Inventory levels higher than desired, requiring aggressive liquidation
Near-term revenue and margin headwinds from marketplace reset actions
key_opportunities: New product innovation pipeline (Pegasus Premium, Vomero 18, Kobe, Sabrina) gaining traction
Sport-led 'fields of play' organizational structure expected to drive innovation
Rebuilding wholesale partner relationships and integrated marketplace
Long-term sport partnership extensions (NFL, NBA, WNBA, Brazil Football Confederation)
Shift to premium full-price model on NIKE Digital expected to improve channel profitability over time

management_tone.label: cautious
